IPT.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/9] Items included in this report focused on (1) child and parent ratings of the how helpful the group was, (2) parent reports of whether they would have liked more family sessions, and (3) parent reports of whether they noticed their children talking about or using the skills taught in the group (e.g., problem-solving, taking their emotional temperature, setting personal goals, relaxation, stopping negative thoughts, saying positive things to others, and planning fun activities).
